The '''CZR-9001 blaster rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Specific blasters were often designed for specific roles in combat.

==Behind the scenes==
The CZR-9001 blaster rifle first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an item that required reputation to purchase at [[CZ-198]]; it comes in numerous named variations with differing stats.
